package migr

import (
	"time"
	"io/ioutil"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

type Store struct {
	w   *dst.World
	dir string
	f   *os.File
}

// world is the Store's World, for -world 'Store=$.world()'.
func (s *Store) world() *dst.World { return s.w }

func (s *Store) open() error {
	if _, err := os.Stat(s.dir); os.IsNotExist(err) {
		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.dir, os.ModePerm); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	f, err := os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(s.dir, "log"), os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR|os.O_APPEND, 0o644)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.f = f
	if _, err := f.WriteString("hello"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return f.Sync()
}

func (s *Store) replace(data []byte) error {
	tmp := filepath.Join(s.dir, "meta.tmp")
	if err := os.WriteFile(tmp, data, 0o644); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := ioutil.WriteFile(tmp+"2", data, 0o644); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_ = os.Remove(tmp + "2")
	_ = os.Link(tmp, tmp+"3")
	if _, err := os.Lstat(tmp); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return os.Rename(tmp, filepath.Join(s.dir, "meta"))
}

func (s *Store) list() ([]string, error) {
	es, err := os.ReadDir(s.dir)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var out []string
	for _, e := range es {
		out = append(out, e.Name())
	}
	b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(s.dir, "meta"))
	if err == nil {
		out = append(out, string(b))
	}
	f, err := os.Open(filepath.Join(s.dir, "log"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	c, err := os.Create(filepath.Join(s.dir, "new"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	c.Close()
	_ = os.Chmod(filepath.Join(s.dir, "new"), 0o600)
	_ = os.Chown(filepath.Join(s.dir, "new"), -1, -1)
	return out, os.RemoveAll(filepath.Join(s.dir, "old"))
}

// drop removes the store.
func (s *Store) drop() error {
	// Attempt to remove all artifacts
	return os.RemoveAll(s.dir)
}

// age is how long ago t was.
func (s *Store) age(t time.Time) time.Duration {
	// Since becomes the World's.
	return time.Since(t)
}

// size takes a file: its type becomes dst.File.
func size(f *os.File) (int64, error) {
	st, err := f.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return st.Size(), nil
}
